import numpy as np, torch, model
net = model.load(); neg = model.negatives()
w=torch.tensor(np.load('contrast_c0_blocks.2.act_k14.npy')); b=-11.1312
def dec(xi,c,dv,lo,hi):
    x=torch.as_tensor(xi,dtype=torch.float32).clone(); c=torch.as_tensor(c,dtype=torch.float32)
    fired=torch.zeros(len(x),dtype=torch.bool)
    for k in range(20):
        t=torch.full((len(x),),1-k/20)
        v,a=net.velocity(x,t,c,("blocks.2.act",),count=False)
        f=(a["blocks.2.act"]@w+b>0)&(lo<=k<hi)
        fired|=f
        v=v+f[:,None].float()*torch.tensor(dv,dtype=torch.float32)
        x=x-v/20
    return x.numpy(),fired.numpy()
